title: Assessing the response of agricultural watershed non-point source pollution to the dual impacts of climate change and human activities
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3180-3191
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00038F, Paper
Shaolei Guo, Yuehan Zhang, Xianqi Zhang, Wanhui Cheng, Xin Wang
This study examines climate and human impacts on agricultural nitrogen pollution using SWAT+. Modeling shows climate dominates, but human contributions are rising. BMPs are key mitigation strategies.
